en_US.title: Shift Crews Not Heroes

en_US.field_note: People are more believable as workers than as memorial statues.

en_US.title: Worker Job Cards
en_US.scanner: A job card is a face the budget could read.
en_US.field_note: Make names useful before making them tragic.
en_US.terminal: JOB CARD LAYER: each recovered name should carry a role, last task, route permission or tool certification. The player learns people through what they were doing when the system failed.
en_US.audio: A name without a task becomes a shrine. A task makes it evidence.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Worker job cards let wiki, terminals and scanner fragments humanize the colony while staying functional for gameplay routes.
en_US.external_site: Worker Job Cards turn names into evidence objects.

en_US.title: Locker Name Protocol
en_US.scanner: A locker is personal without needing a family plot.
en_US.field_note: The smallest human trace should survive corporate cleanup.
en_US.terminal: LOCKER RULE: lockers hold tool wear, correction notes, shift stickers, pressure tape and names Deep Reach tried to remove from payroll. Marauder annotations preserve what the company normalized away.
en_US.audio: The company deleted the employee. The rust kept the label.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Locker name plates make workers legible through objects: badge, role, route permission, and the thing left unfinished.
en_US.external_site: Locker Name Protocol is personal evidence without melodrama.

en_US.title: Medical Triage Ledger
en_US.scanner: The medics knew the system was making patients faster than they could treat them.
en_US.field_note: Medical text should count bodies without becoming gore.
en_US.terminal: TRIAGE LEDGER: pressure injury, hypoxia, lock delay, missing route and certification hold. The horror is not blood; it is how neatly the ledger explains why help waited.
en_US.audio: The cleanest handwriting is on the worst page.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Medical triage evidence lets the colony feel human while tying Deep Reach guilt to procedure, not cartoon violence.
en_US.external_site: Medical Triage Ledger is the human cost of delayed evacuation.

en_US.title: Marauder Correction Layer
en_US.scanner: Marauders turn corporate language back into survival facts.
en_US.field_note: The player should feel old Deep Reach language being translated into body count.
en_US.terminal: CORRECTION LAYER: a company label says temporary atmospheric variance. A Marauder note says CO2 eats judgment first. The correction is short because the next diver needs it under pressure.
en_US.audio: A good note does not sound clever. It keeps someone alive.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Marauder corrections let world writing stay short, useful and angry. They also show the player's new culture fighting the language that trained them.
en_US.external_site: Marauder Correction Layer is the tone bridge between Deep Reach procedure and player agency.
